sequence_generation: First 4400 terms where available, source initial values; retain sequences of at least 500 terms. Use values modulo 28 after generation. The primeidx entry duplicates prime in this source code and is kept for source parity but not a distinct hypothesis.
bijections: s-1, 28-s, and discrete logarithm modulo 29 for primitive roots 2,3,8,10,11,14,15,18,19,21,26,27; zero difference is a masked placeholder
scan: First min(500, rune count minus one) adjacent differences per section; offsets 0..299; signs +1 and -1; A consumes key positions at doublets, B does not; maximize 28-normalized index of coincidence after subtracting candidate key.
positive_controls: Encrypt the first 1500 GP runes of the pinned baseline with prime values modulo 28 starting at prime index 50, mapping EA to zero difference. Test both consume-at-EA conventions using the exact full grid; planted prime schedule should be recovered among source-equivalent winners.
selected_control: 39 seeded within-section rune-order shuffles of p54-55, repeating the complete source grid and retaining the maximum score; source receipt already reports this section as the largest LP2 best, so the control is conditional/post-source-selection.
claim_limit: Source rule/output replay plus one conditional selected-grid control. A high IoC does not identify a key or validate a plaintext; this does not exclude other chain generators.
